correctness.rationale: The stationary identities reconstruct directly from the generator. Invariance gives \(\langle z\rangle=\langle x\rangle=\langle xz\rangle=0\), \(\langle xy\rangle=-q\), and \(\langle yz\rangle=q\). Exact polynomial differentiation of the inspected certificate gives \(LG=a+5y-x^2\), hence \(\langle y\rangle=-a/5+q/5\). Since \(\operatorname{Var}(x+y)=\operatorname{Var}(y)-q\), the variance bound follows. Equality makes \(x+y\) constant on the invariant support; differentiating along the flow forces \(x=z=0\) and then \(y=-a/5\), so equality occurs only for the equilibrium Dirac mass. The periodic-orbit amplitude statement is then the elementary maximum-versus-variance bound.
